The Axis powers , [ nb 1 ] originally called the Rome–Berlin Axis [ 1 ] and also Rome–Berlin–Tokyo Axis , was the military coalition which initiated World War II and fought against the Allies . Its principal members were Nazi Germany , the Kingdom of Italy and the Empire of Japan . The Axis were united in their far-right positions
and general opposition to the Allies, but otherwise lacked comparable coordination and ideological cohesion.
